Name: BFAV Golden Goose
Author: MythicFenix
Description:
BFAV version of the Golden Goose mod.  Thanks to SpringsSong for converting the mod and making it drop the golden items from my CP version of the mod.

If you have Artisan Valley, you can get goose mayo.  However Artisan Valley isn't required for this mod to work.
[b]
[code][/code]Install Instructions:[/b]
[*]Install Paritee's Better Farm Animal Variety (BFAV) (must be version 3.0.6-unofficial or newer)

[*]Install Json Assets.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it's contents.
[*]Copy the [BFAV] AND [JA] into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
Run the game using SMAPI.
